name: Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu
lede: I study Computer Engineering in Istanbul and build products by directing AI agents. I'm drawn to the low level: processors, embedded systems, the machine's own language.
description: Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu: Computer Engineering at Yıldız Technical University, Istanbul. Products built by directing AI agents, and a record of the work.

now.label: Now, October 2026
now.text: First term of Computer Engineering at YTU. Recto is in public beta; English Prep is at 0.75.

work.title: Products I direct
work.dek: I write the specs, make the decisions and review what AI agents build. Open one to see what it is, why it exists, how it is made and what comes next.
work.byHand: Work I write myself, without agents: course problem sets, low-level experiments, contributions. It gets its own lighter format, and appears here as it happens.

log.title: The record
log.dek: What I did, why, and what I'm building. Some entries are a line, some are a few pages.
log.writingNote: I dictate the notes, often in Turkish; an agent edits them into English and I read every draft before it goes up.
log.empty: Nothing is published yet. Entries appear here as they are written, each with its date.

about.title: Hi, I'm Eren.
ledes: I'm a first-year Computer Engineering student at Yıldız Technical University in Istanbul. I passed the English prep year with AA, full marks.
I like what sits closest to the machine, and I build products by directing AI agents.
